rationale: For an operational hotel management dashboard used by staff on the go, a clean, high-contrast, function-first 'Vercel/Linear' aesthetic reduces cognitive load and prevents fatigue. The UI relies on stark whites, subtle zincs, and 1px borders, using color purely for status semantics rather than decoration.

typography.rationale: Chivo provides a dense, technical authority for data-heavy dashboard headers, while IBM Plex Sans brings sterile, highly legible clarity to the body and dense data tables.

scale.labels: font-sans text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.05em] uppercase text-muted-foreground

css_variables.instruction: Replace the existing :root variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css with these values. Update tailwind.config.js to map font-heading to Chivo and font-sans to IBM Plex Sans.

tailwind_patterns.primary_button: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm rounded-md transition-all font-medium h-9 px-4 text-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2
tailwind_patterns.secondary_button: bg-white text-foreground border border-border hover:bg-zinc-50 shadow-sm rounded-md transition-all font-medium h-9 px-4 text-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2
tailwind_patterns.destructive_button: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 shadow-sm rounded-md transition-all font-medium h-9 px-4 text-sm inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2
tailwind_patterns.input: border border-input bg-background rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-1 transition-all
tailwind_patterns.tab_nav_container: flex w-full overflow-x-auto border-b border-border bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl sticky top-0 z-50 hide-scrollbar
tailwind_patterns.tab_item: flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap
tailwind_patterns.stat_card: flex flex-col gap-1 p-5 bg-card border border-border rounded-md shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden
tailwind_patterns.modal_content: fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] bg-card border border-border shadow-xl rounded-lg w-full max-w-md p-6

badge_variants.base: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide border

login_screen.layout: Split layout: 50% minimal login form (left), 50% architectural image (right) on desktop. Stacked on mobile.
login_screen.background: White on the form side. The provided image URL should cover the right panel fully.
login_screen.form_styling: Centered, narrow max-width (400px). Minimal inputs, 1px border, stark black primary button, no heavy shadows.

top_tab_nav.styling: Glassmorphic sticky header. Strip out pill shapes or background blobs. Use Linear-style thin bottom-border for active tabs. Replace emojis with Lucide icons (size 16px). Ensure horizontal scroll on mobile.

time_clock.layout: Control Room style: Centralized, high-focus widget. Huge, crisp typography for the current time using font-mono or tabular-nums.
time_clock.buttons: Massive 'Punch In' (Solid Black/Primary) / 'Punch Out' (Outline/Destructive) buttons. Flat design, no gradients.
time_clock.status_indicator: Use a subtle pulsing dot (8px) next to 'Online/Offline' text. Green for Online, Zinc/Red for Offline.

room_management_grid.layout: Dense bento-grid. gap-4 on desktop. Cards must have identical aspect ratios or stretch.
room_management_grid.card_styling: Flat background with 1px border. Do NOT flood the whole card with color. Use a 4px left border (e.g., border-l-4 border-l-emerald-500) or a clean badge inside to indicate status. Dropdowns should be crisp and minimal.

before_after_feel.before: A standard, slightly dated Bootstrap/Tailwind hybrid. Emoji-heavy, generic pill tabs, colorful gradient buttons, large drop shadows, and inconsistent rounded corners.
before_after_feel.after: A surgical, high-end operational tool. Looks like it was built by Linear or Vercel. Whitespace is intentional, borders are crisp (1px), colors are reserved strictly for semantic states (Clean vs Dirty), typography is authoritative, and navigation feels anchored and premium.

mobile_breakpoint_guidance.navigation: Top tabs must remain at the top but scroll horizontally (overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar). Do NOT collapse into a hamburger menu.
mobile_breakpoint_guidance.grids: Room grid transitions to 1 column (grid-cols-1) or 2 dense columns (grid-cols-2 gap-2) to keep information dense and accessible without excessive vertical scrolling.
mobile_breakpoint_guidance.typography: Scale down h1 to text-2xl or text-3xl on mobile. Ensure all tap targets (buttons, dropdowns) are at least 44px tall for fat-finger friendliness.

image_urls.description: Modern lounge area with marble walls and ambient lighting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this strictly via Tailwind class replacements in App.js and updating the CSS variables in index.css. Do NOT split App.js. Do NOT change application logic, routing, or React state. Replace all emojis with the provided Lucide icons. For fonts, ensure Chivo and IBM Plex Sans are imported in App.css or index.css and mapped in tailwind.config.js theme.extend.fontFamily.
